title: Dashboard storefront link ignores the primary host
summary: The card builds the storefront host of the [[tenant]] itself instead of reading `storefrontUrl`.
reproduce: Open `/dashboard` while it is still provisioning.
expected: The primary host, and a note while the storefront is not open.

title: Retrying a failed OTA ignores the tenant limit
summary: A failed OTA frees its slot, and a retry does not count again.
reproduce: Fail one OTA, create another, retry the first.
actual: `202`, two OTAs that are not failed.
fix: Count the owner's OTAs in `retryProvisioning` too.

title: Tenant status values allowed by the CHECK constraint that no code writes
summary: No code writes `deprovisioning` or `deleted` to `tenants.status`, yet the admin filter offers both.
reproduce: Filter the admin's tenant list by status Deleted: always empty.
expected: Only values that can occur are offered.
actual: Reserved values are offered and documented as used.
fix: Narrow the CHECK constraint in a new migration, or mark the values as reserved.
